_note: Festival 'months' are the usual months. Dates change every year, so the site always tells readers to confirm before going.

cities.name: Seoul
cities.label: top
cities.tagline: Palaces, street food, K-pop and nightlife in one huge, easy-to-navigate capital.

festivals.name: KBO baseball season
festivals.when: Late March to October (playoffs into November)
festivals.about: Night games at Jamsil and Gocheok Sky Dome on most days except Mondays. Cheap seats, loud chants, chicken and beer.

festivals.name: Seoul Marathon
festivals.about: One of Asia's oldest marathons, through central Seoul. Entries open months ahead.

festivals.name: Yeouido Spring Flower Festival
festivals.about: Cherry blossoms along the Han River and Yunjung-ro.

festivals.name: Lotus Lantern Festival
festivals.about: A UNESCO-listed lantern parade through downtown Seoul.

festivals.name: Seoul International Fireworks Festival
festivals.about: One evening of huge fireworks over Yeouido. Arrive by mid-afternoon.

festivals.name: Seoul Lantern Festival
festivals.about: Light installations along Cheonggyecheon Stream, free to walk.

cities.name: Busan
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: Korea's beach city: seafood markets, hillside villages and temples by the sea.

festivals.name: Lotte Giants home games
festivals.about: Sajik Stadium is famous for Korea's most passionate baseball crowd.

festivals.name: Haeundae Sand Festival
festivals.about: Giant sand sculptures on Haeundae Beach.

festivals.name: Busan Sea Festival
festivals.about: Beach concerts and events across the city's beaches.

festivals.name: Busan International Film Festival
festivals.about: Asia's biggest film festival, with open-air screenings and star sightings.

festivals.name: Busan Fireworks Festival
festivals.about: Fireworks over Gwangan Bridge, seen from Gwangalli Beach.

cities.name: Jeju
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: A volcanic island of craters, beaches, tangerine farms and women free-divers.

festivals.name: Jeju Fire Festival
festivals.about: A traditional spring festival at Saebyeol Oreum. The program changes year to year.

festivals.name: Canola flower season
festivals.about: Yellow canola fields, often alongside cherry blossoms, around Seogwipo.

festivals.name: Tangerine season
festivals.about: Farms open for tangerine picking. Look for 귤따기 signs.

cities.name: Gyeongju
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: The 1,000-year capital of the Silla kingdom, a museum without walls.

festivals.name: Cherry blossoms at Bomun Lake
festivals.about: One of Korea's best cherry blossom spots, around Bomun Lake and Daereungwon.

festivals.name: Silla Culture Festival
festivals.about: Parades and performances celebrating Silla history.

festivals.name: Autumn foliage
festivals.about: Ginkgo and maple peak at Bulguksa, Tongiljeon and Ungok Seowon.

cities.name: Jeonju
cities.label: left
cities.tagline: Korea's food capital, with a hanok village of about 700 traditional houses.

festivals.name: Jeonju International Film Festival
festivals.about: A festival for independent and arthouse film.

festivals.name: Jeonju Bibimbap Festival
festivals.about: Giant communal bibimbap and food events in the hanok village.

cities.name: Incheon
cities.label: left
cities.tagline: Where most visitors land: a historic port, Chinatown and a futuristic new city.

festivals.name: Incheon Pentaport Rock Festival
festivals.about: Korea's biggest rock festival, three days in Songdo.

cities.name: Suwon
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: A UNESCO-listed fortress city, an easy half-day trip from Seoul.

festivals.name: Suwon Hwaseong Cultural Festival
festivals.about: A reenactment of King Jeongjo's royal procession and fortress events.

cities.name: Gapyeong & Nami
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: Riverside day trip from Seoul: Nami Island, gardens and a K-drama theme village.

festivals.name: Jarasum Jazz Festival
festivals.about: Outdoor jazz on a river island, with picnics on the lawn.

festivals.name: Garden of Morning Calm lights
festivals.about: The whole garden lit up after dark.

cities.name: Gangneung
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: East coast beaches, Korea's coffee town and sunrise over the sea.

festivals.name: Gangneung Danoje Festival
festivals.about: A UNESCO-listed traditional festival with rituals, mask plays and a huge market.

festivals.name: Gangneung Coffee Festival
festivals.about: Roasters and cafés from across the country.

festivals.name: New Year sunrise
festivals.about: Crowds gather at Gyeongpo and Jeongdongjin for the first sunrise.

festivals.name: Ski season in Pyeongchang
festivals.about: Yongpyong and Phoenix, the 2018 Olympic resorts, are about 40 minutes away. Opening dates are announced in November.

cities.name: Sokcho & Seoraksan
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: Korea's most famous mountains meet a seafood harbor town.

festivals.name: Seoraksan autumn foliage
festivals.about: Usually the first big foliage in Korea. Weekends are very busy.

festivals.name: New Year sunrise
festivals.about: First-sunrise gatherings at Sokcho Beach.

festivals.name: Surf season in Yangyang
festivals.about: Surf schools line Jukdo and Ingu beaches; autumn brings the most consistent waves.

cities.name: Andong
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: Korea's Confucian heartland, with a living UNESCO village and mask dances.

festivals.name: Andong Maskdance Festival
festivals.about: Mask dance troupes from Korea and abroad, plus the Hahoe village fire show.

cities.name: Daegu
cities.label: left
cities.tagline: A big, local-feeling city of night markets, modern history and mountain temples.

festivals.name: Daegu Chimac Festival
festivals.about: Fried chicken and beer (chimaek) with concerts, in Korea's hottest city.

cities.name: Yeosu
cities.label: left
cities.tagline: A romantic south-coast harbor known for its night sea and island views.

festivals.name: Yeongchwisan Azalea Festival
festivals.about: Hillsides covered in pink azaleas.

festivals.name: Yeosu Turtle Ship Festival
festivals.about: Celebrates Admiral Yi Sun-sin and his turtle ships.

festivals.name: Hyangiram Sunrise Festival
festivals.about: Watch the first sunrise of the year from the cliffside hermitage.

cities.name: Tongyeong
cities.label: right
cities.tagline: The 'Naples of Korea': islands, seafood and an artistic harbor town.

festivals.name: Tongyeong International Music Festival
festivals.about: Classical music in honor of composer Isang Yun, born in Tongyeong.

festivals.name: Hansan Daecheop Festival
festivals.about: Reenacts Admiral Yi's 1592 naval victory, with boats on the harbor.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.tip: Cherry blossoms move north from late March to mid-April. Bring a light jacket.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.tip: Hot and humid, with a rainy season from late June to July. Beaches open in July.

seasons.name: Autumn
seasons.tip: The best season for most visitors. Foliage peaks from mid-October to mid-November.

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.tip: Cold and dry. Pack layers; ski resorts and winter lights are at their best.
